newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Bank sets HK$2.0 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Bank sets HK$2.0 bln FRCD.

text.p: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Ltd, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, has launched a HK$2.0 billion floating rate certificate of deposit issue due May 2000, said arranger HSBC Markets.
The three-year certificates were priced at par to pay a coupon of 22 basis points over the one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. There are no puts or calls.
With fees, the all-in return is 27 basis points to top-tier participants.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the certificates for use at its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
The issue is off the bank's HK$20 billion CD programme.
Details of the issue are as follows:
